name: ui-review
description: UI Review: review a website or app interface through 12 UI lenses and get a visual report with annotated screenshots plus a hands-off brief for AI agents.

plugins.name: ui-review
plugins.description: Review a UI (live site, app, screenshots or Figma) for hierarchy, layout, typography, colour and contrast, usability, navigation, forms, states, accessibility, responsiveness, microcopy and design-system consistency; get an evidence-based, render-checked HTML report with annotated screenshots and a task file for AI agents.
